Sorry... it's okay... yahi hai internet ka three-way handshake! Oracle ne Applications Developer One, fresher role ke interview mein, yahi sawaal poocha... aur package? Pure atharah lakh ka CTC! Chalo, tees second mein samjho!
Client ko server se data chahiye. Socho, bas query bheji, aur data aa gaya? Nahi! Pehle dono ke beech connection banna zaroori hai, aur wo banta hai teen steps mein.
Step one: SYN, yaani Synchronize! Client server ko SYN packet bhejta hai, ek random sequence number ke saath... maan lo X.
Step two: SYN-Acknowledgement! Server kehta hai: tumhara SYN packet mere paas aa chuka hai! Isliye Acknowledgement number bhejta hai, X plus one. Aur saath mein apna SYN bhi, sequence number Y.
Step three: Acknowledgement! Client kehta hai: tumhara SYN bhi mujhe mil gaya, Acknowledgement Y plus one. Ab connection established, aur data flow shuru!
Interviewer ka twist: do steps kyun nahi? Kyunki dono taraf ka sequence number confirm hona zaroori hai!
Ek line mein yaad rakho: SYN, SYN-Acknowledgement, Acknowledgement! Aise hi interview concepts ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
